items.transcript: If your kitchen is clean, but it sinks, chances are the smell is coming out of one of these three places. Let's go. Number one, the fridge. Just go make sure that you don't have any spoiled food, and if you do, throw it away. Number two, your garbage disposal. It is super easy to clean. Just throw one of these things in there with hot water, turn it on, and you're done. Last but not least, your garbage. Yep, if your kitchen is clean, but it sinks, chances are it's your garbage. Take it out. How pretty!

items.transcript: We're taking it back to basics. This is how to clean your countertops like a professional housekeeper would. Let's go. The first thing I do is I always go down to the level of the countertop so that I can see everything really well. This is the only point of view that will show you everything. And we're going to keep it very nice and simple, some Dawn Power Wash and a Scrub Mommy sponge. That's it. You can use this combination on quartz, marble, granite, you name it. Then rinse it using a damp microfiber towel. After that, we go back down one more time to eye level to make sure that we didn't leave any crumbs or trash. Now don't forget to save this video for the next time you need it.

items.transcript: As someone who spent the last nine years cleaning houses for other people, yes, I was a housekeeper, I'm going to give you my biggest cleaning tip. Let's go. Stop mopping your bathroom floors with the mop you use to mop the rest of your house. In my opinion, it's just not sanitary. I recommend using a bucket and the two-towel method. That means one towel is always wet and the other towel remains dry so that you can dry your floors. And remember, you don't have to do this on your knees. You can use like a sweeper mop to help you out. And for this, I like to use my favorite cleaning recipe, which I will leave you right here, but it's also inside my e-book, which I have for sale.

items.caption:
Boiling water for mopping is an extreme measure that you should only be doing once in awhile when your floors are nasty and only if you have tile floors. laminate, wood, vinyl, or marble you cannot use boiling water to clean your floors. Not only will you be messing up your floors but your mop will be messed up. It is so unnecessary! Warm water is just fine.
•
#cleanwithme #clean #cleaningtips #trending
items.transcript: This might be controversial, but you need to stop copying everything you see that people do on the internet, especially when it comes to cleaning videos. You do not need to be boiling water every single time you mop, unless it is actual tile, not wood, and not laminate floors. And the only reason why I boiled water was because this floor was crusty, and I mean crusty. Otherwise, you do not need to be boiling water every single time you mop your floors, you're just going to damage them, and you also don't need half a bottle of cleaner. Trust me.

items.transcript: With the lack of empathy that people nowadays have for each other, I always try to keep it at the front of my free cleanings because it is that empathy, that love for people that are strangers to me that keep me moving forward. That is why when we do the free cleanings, we don't only do the cleaning, but we also change things that need changing. For example, an old dirty mattress, yes, we replace it with a brand new clean one. And if I buy new bed sheets and blankets, I take them to my own house to wash them so that they can sleep in a clean bed, not just a new bed, but a clean bed. And even though it's something small, to the people that live here, it means everything.
